mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which compress equity risk premiums and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the signal of UNRATE rising >0.2pp fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth in the prior quarter fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falling below 100 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment that increases equity risk premiums, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 2000.0), a monthly decline in housing starts below 1.0% signals a cooling in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the housing boom regime (HOUST > 2000.0), the signal of HOUST falling >1.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
